trace.question: What proportion of single bonds are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.
trace.evidence: single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; proportion = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+') * 100, COUNT(bond_id)) where bond_type = '-'

attempts.sql:
SELECT printf('%.5f', SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id)) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT printf('%.5f', SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id)) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
trace.answer: The proportion of single bonds that are carcinogenic is 39.75203%.
